1829-1981-2415-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1829-1981-2415-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3197-6872-8095.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
3197-6872-8095.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2843-3175-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1170-2921-5131-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2921-5131-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1170-2921-5131-7010--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

4365-4772-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-4772-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Doubling Season.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1270-4772-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 7^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 42 after the first iteration, 294 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

2104-7722-7843.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Elrond.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-1739-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2112-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-6797-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1496-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

240-413-955-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1169-1563-3899-4772.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

586-1472-5626-6798.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-5626-6798.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

3661-4050-4053-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that has power or toughness 1 or less and that can be cast using one colored mana.
3661-4050-4053-6989.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from your graveyard by paying its mana cost. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

640-2438-5010-6900.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2173-3652-5220-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1825-5928-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Balduvian Trading Post and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-5928-6760.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Balduvian Trading Post and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

3967-4681-4730-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

527-5140-5686.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-5140-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-5140-5686.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Selvala, creating a Blood token.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-5140-5686.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

372-695-2239.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-695-2239.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Ardent Elementalist and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Ardent Elementalist trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Ardent Elementalist and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

813-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Scholar of the Ages.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Clone Legion and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Scholar of the Ages.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-4661.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Vesuvan Doppelganger and another permanent you control.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

413-877-4254-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
413-877-4254-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

352-4036-5195.description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping it, adding {U} or {R}.
Activate Nivix Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{U}{R}, copying Seething Song.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

618-1558-3263-3907.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Underworld Hermit with haste.
When the Underworld Hermit token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Underworld Hermit token and the Squirrel tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

706-1170-4074.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery card
706-1170-4074.notablePrerequisites:
You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
706-1170-4074.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery card from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of the instant or sorcery.
Holding priority, cast Spelljack by paying {3}{U}{U}{U}, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten triggers.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Spelljack that is targeting the original Spelljack.
Resolve the copy of Spelljack, countering the original Spelljack and exiling it with the ability to cast it for free from exile.
Cast Spelljack from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Repeat from step 6.

2034-5003-5004.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
Cathodion and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

250-779-1742.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Dakmor Salvage, adding {B}.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
